description: Digitale Nivellementnetzkarte Land Brandenburg is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesvermessung und Geobasisinformation Brandenburg (LGB). LGB is giving 3 with the completion of the levelling network. Order a digital map of levelling nets 1: 300,000 in the state of Brandenburg. The card is 60 MB in size and can be downloaded as a PDF file or available as a CD. The map contains the levelling lines 1.- 4. Coverage: Landesvermessung und Geobasisinformation Brandenburg (LGB). The portal shows the English title as "Digital levelling network map Land Brandenburg" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Landesvermessung und Geobasisinformation Brandenburg (LGB). Its keywords include opendata, Koordinaten, Amtliche Karte, 1:200.000 - 1:500.000, CD-ROM, Festpunkte. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
